title: Proper exchange for a simplicial etale augmentation
statement:
Let $a:U_\bullet\to X$ be an augmented simplicial scheme [def-pc-scheme] such that every component augmentation $a_p:U_p\to X$ is proper [def-weil-proper-morphism]. Let $g:Y\to X$ be any scheme morphism, let $V_\bullet=U_\bullet\times_XY$ [def-pc-fibre-product], let $a':V_\bullet\to Y$ be the augmentation and $g_\bullet:V_\bullet\to U_\bullet$ the projection. The total etale topoi have sheaves described by component sheaves and compatible inverse-image transition maps, as in [lem-trf-simplicial-derived-image-spectral-sequence]. Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative ring annihilated by an integer $m\ge1$, and let $L\in D^+(U_\bullet,\Lambda)$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. The ordinary adjunction-mate exchange map is an isomorphism
$$g^*Ra_*L\xrightarrow{\sim}Ra'_*g_\bullet^*L.$$
It is natural in $L$, respects the canonical derived composition identifications for maps of augmented simplicial schemes, and uses the units and counits of the ordinary inverse-image/direct-image adjunctions. No Cartesianity condition on the transition maps of $L$, constructibility, finite-type hypothesis on $Y$, or upper cohomological bound on $L$ is imposed.

source.place: Tag 0D7F (lemma-augmentation-spectral-sequence-modules) and Tag 0D99 (lemma-morphism-augmentation-simplicial-sites), applied to the degreewise proper exchange of etale-cohomology.tex Tag 095T (theorem-proper-base-change); the simplicial use is also explicit in Orgogozo Lemma 3.1.1, p. 6, both displayed isomorphisms.
